coverImageAlt: Loose navy, cyan, and orange cords braided into one rising strand beneath a stage spotlight.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: several raw story threads—pain, insight, personal stake, proof, and action—are braided into one luminous narrative line that rises into a keynote spotlight
Scene/backdrop: quiet navy stage atmosphere above a warm paper base with generous empty space
Subject: one braided cyan and slate cord gathering distinct strands at the base, arcing upward through a simple aperture into a restrained cone of light; one orange strand provides the emotional through-line
Style/medium: premium tactile editorial illustration with woven fiber, cut paper stage forms, and dimensional sculptural detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; strong ascending sweep toward a single spotlight; crop-safe focal subject; no essential detail in the outer 8%; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width
Lighting/mood: confident, human, consequential, quietly inspiring
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Materials/textures: woven cord, matte paper, subtle stage fabric, soft volumetric light
Constraints: no podium branding, audience signage, or marked paper; original composition; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, product UI, vendor logos, trademarks, watermarks, paws, paw imagery, paw logos, cats, cat silhouettes, or Microsoft Fluent styling
Avoid: microphones, speech bubbles, generic business presenter, corporate stock photography, screens, slide decks, glitter, clutter
